hash_semantics.removed_paths.sha256: SHA-256 of canonical original Git blob content at source_revision; excludes Git object header.
hash_semantics.archives.sha256: SHA-256 of canonical original Git blob content, identical to archive file bytes; excludes Git object header.
hash_semantics.original_checkout_sha256: SHA-256 of the Windows working-tree bytes captured before cleanup, possibly CRLF-converted; not a Git blob content hash.
hash_semantics.git_blob: Original Git blob object ID (SHA-1 in this repository), including Git object framing in its computation; distinct from the SHA-256 content digest.
hash_semantics.standalone_sha256: Historical pre-cleanup Windows checkout SHA-256 snapshot, not canonical Git blob hashes or current documentation hashes. task_a/README.md received the explicitly authorized Linux-download navigation correction after this snapshot.
hash_semantics.existing_evidence_sha256: Historical pre-cleanup Windows checkout SHA-256 snapshot; existing evidence files remain unchanged.
